## Case study

# Sample Shop Refresh

## The problem

A small online shop selling handmade desk accessories had too many products packed into one crowded landing page. Visitors had to work to find the item that suited them, and the shop needed a clearer path from browsing to checkout.

## What changed

The refreshed page uses a simple product grid, short descriptions, and one obvious route to checkout. Its storefront and layout artwork are represented by `sample-shop-hero.png` and `sample-shop-fig1-roles.png` in this fictional fixture.
